texts.44eaa5f1c0f2: Primary objectives. (1) To evaluate via a multicentre clinical trial the value of contrast enhanced MRI in screening women at genetic risk of breast cancer. (2) To determine the sensitivity and specificity of contrast enhanced MRI screening in this young age group in comparison with conventional techniques. (3) To determine the psychological impact of an MRI screening service offered to women at high risk of breast cancer. (4) To address Prioity L of the NHS R and D Priorities in Cancer. Secondary Objectives. (1) To determine reporting criteria and functional measurement parameters to maximise sensitivity and specificity of contrast enhanced MRI. (2) To implement and assess objective analysis methodology for MRI Measurements. (3) To assess the potential role of MRI for screening lower risk groups and in the wider population as an adjunct to conventional screening for examining equivocal cases. (4) To compare MR visible lesions and structures with breast morphology.
